test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom

Pedal to the metal

options.text: To enjoy yourself by going out.
To go full speed, especially while driving a vehicle.
Avoid responsibility by giving it to someone else.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** "Pedal to the metal"** means **"To go full speed, especially while driving a vehicle"** (गाडी को पूरी स्पीड पर चलाना).
 
• This is a **common idiom used to** describe someone driving very fast.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'To go full speed, especially while driving a vehicle.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Very excessive **(बहुत अधिक) does not match with the idiom.
 
• **To enjoy yourself by going out** (बाहर जाकर आनंद लेना) does not convey the same meaning.
 
• **Avoid responsibility by giving it to someone else** (जिम्मेदारी से बचना और उसे किसी और को देना) is not related to the idiom.

38:T846,

The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**
